name: Bishop Heber College
summary: Bishop Heber College was founded in 1966 by the Tiruchirappalli–Thanjavur Diocese of the Church of South India. It has been autonomous since 2004–05 and is accredited A++ (CGPA 3.69) by NAAC. It runs a government-aided section and, since 1985, a self-financed section in two shifts, with 65+ programmes across 30+ departments.
